internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rate in Checkout Service Due to Payment Service Error Injection
internal.body:
At 12:12 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Initial diagnosis identified a payment service error injection as the primary cause, supported by the paymentFailure flag set to 100% and corresponding error messages. Secondary latency issues in the cart service were noted but not the root cause. 

Actions taken included disabling the paymentFailure flag at 12:32 UTC after approval, which led to a verified recovery with error rates returning to normal levels. The incident was resolved promptly with no ongoing impact.

Key timeline events:
- 12:12:49 Alert received
- 12:32:38 Diagnosis confirmed payment error injection
- 12:32:44 Flag disabled after approval
- 12:32:44 Recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment processing errors
external.body: Between 12:12 and 12:32 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to errors in the payment processing system. Our team identified the problem quickly and implemented a fix that resolved the issue. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent similar issues in the future.
